acceptTransfer(address).details: Reverts with NoPendingTransfer unless the proposal targets the caller and      matches the holder's current name. Reverts with RecipientHasName if the      caller already holds a name. Acceptance immediately changes resolution,      clears the proposal and release metadata, and leaves the sender nameless.      No reservation is created and no funds are moved.

params.from: Holder whose pending proposal the caller accepts.

cancelTransfer().details: Reverts with NoPendingTransfer if no proposal exists; ownership is unchanged.

claim(string).details: The caller must hold no name. During a reservation only the previous owner      may claim; at exactly releasedAt + RESERVATION_PERIOD anyone may claim.      Successful claims clear all release metadata for the name.      Every successful claim, including reserved reclaims, incurs the same fee.      Approve this registry to spend claimFee before claiming.      Fees move directly to feeRecipient after state updates; payment failure reverts      the entire claim. No refunds are provided. Release and transfer operations remain free.

params.name: Exact lowercase ASCII name to claim; no normalization is performed.

constructor.details: Rejects zero token/recipient addresses, token/self recipients, zero fees, and fees above MAX_CLAIM_FEE.      There is no administrator or mechanism to update these values after deployment.

params.claimFee_: Nonzero fee in USDC base units, at most MAX_CLAIM_FEE.
params.feeRecipient_: Wallet its owner expects to stay usable. If blacklisted by      the USDC issuer, fee-bearing claims revert forever while blacklisted because      the recipient is immutable and cannot be replaced.

isAvailable(string).details: Independent of msg.sender and whether any prospective caller already holds a name.

returns.available: True if the name is publicly available to claim.

isAvailableFor(string,address).details: Checks name availability only, not whether who already holds another name.      A true result does not waive claim's one-name-per-wallet requirement.

params.name: Exact name to query.
params.who: Prospective claimant whose reservation rights should be considered.

returns.available: True if no owner or reservation prevents who from claiming the name.

isValidName(string).details: Validation loops over at most MAX_NAME_LENGTH bytes; non-ASCII bytes fail.

returns.valid: True exactly when the name satisfies every rule.

returns.name: Current name, or an empty string if the wallet holds none.

returns.nameHash: Hash of the offered name, or bytes32(0) if no proposal exists.
returns.to: Proposed recipient, or address(0) if no proposal exists.

proposeTransfer(address).details: Reverts with NoName, ZeroAddress, or SameAddress for invalid proposals.      Replaces any earlier proposal without changing ownership or resolution.      The recipient may already hold a name, but must hold none when accepting.

params.to: Nonzero recipient wallet, distinct from the caller.

release().details: Resolution returns address(0) immediately. Reclaiming still requires holding      no other name. Reverts with NoName if the caller holds none.      Any pending transfer proposed by the caller is cleared.

params.name: Exact name to resolve, without normalization.

returns.wallet: Current owner, or address(0) if the name is invalid or unclaimed.

MIN_NAME_LENGTH().notice: Minimum permitted name length in bytes.

RESERVATION_PERIOD().notice: Exclusive reclaim window for the wallet that released a name.

cancelTransfer().notice: Cancel the caller's pending transfer proposal.

claim(string).notice: Claim a valid, unclaimed name for the caller, paying claimFee.

claimFee().notice: Immutable nonzero fee per successful claim in USDC base units.

constructor.notice: Configure the token, fee recipient, and per-claim fee permanently.

feeRecipient().notice: Immutable wallet receiving claim fees directly from claimers.

isValidName(string).notice: Check all onchain name rules without normalizing the input.

nameOf(address).notice: Look up a wallet's current name.

ownerOf(bytes32).notice: Current owner of a name hash, or address(0) when unclaimed.

pendingTransferOf(address).notice: Look up a holder's pending transfer proposal.
